notes:
Fix missing GSTINs right from the app — no more switching to Tally:

When "Build Purchase Register" finds vendors with no GSTIN saved in Tally, a dialog now opens right there listing every one of them. Type each vendor's GSTIN in and Save — it's written straight to that vendor's ledger in Tally (Set/Alter GST Details), same as doing it inside Tally itself. Close the dialog and the register rebuilds automatically, now including the vendors you just fixed.
